headline: 2007 executive order directs federal agencies to work together on greenhouse gas emissions from cars, other vehicles, and engines.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to cooperate when they take steps to protect the environment from greenhouse gas emissions. It covers emissions from motor vehicles, as well as from nonroad vehicles and engines. No official summary was provided, so the specific duties it gives each agency are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that deal with the environment, transportation, and energy
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to coordinate their work on rules about greenhouse gas emissions from vehicles and engines.

who_it_affects.group: Makers of cars, trucks, and nonroad vehicles and engines
who_it_affects.how: Their products are the subject of the emissions work the agencies are told to coordinate on.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 14, 2007; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
